title: Credit Department Determination on the Combined Feed Balance Across a Member's Programmes
content:
What a member owes the mill is looked at across every feed programme they hold rather than programme by programme. The combined feed balance is what stands unpaid on every programme that is not closed, and it is measured against the sum of the limits those programmes carry. A load is run only where the combined balance after the invoice would stay at or under the combined limit, so a member at their ceiling on the finisher ration cannot be supplied on the starter instead.

## What the combined balance is made of

The balance is taken across every feed programme of the member within the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes that is not closed, as those programmes stand on the day the matter is handled, and it is the money owed on invoices raised and still unpaid, less the payments applied against them. The limit it is measured against is the sum of the unpaid balance each of those programmes will carry, each programme contributing the limit its own terms of account set, and whether settlement proceeds may be credited to the account is likewise a matter of the individual programme.

## Billing a delivered load

Before a delivered load is invoiced, the programme it is billed to stands active, and the invoice is identified by its own invoice number, which is what ties the charge to the programme and the member. The standing of the programme is read from the mill's records rather than taken from the member's account of it.

## Applying money received

A payment that names no invoice is applied to the programme it was received on, oldest invoice first, and is never spread across programmes. Contracted ingredient tons belong to the programme they were contracted on and are never drawn by another, because the contract was written against that formula. Where the member has elected to have grain settlement proceeds credited to the feed account and the programme allows the transfer, the whole net lands as one payment on the settlement date.

## Points of judgement

| The position | How it reads |
| --- | --- |
| Combined balance after the invoice equal to the combined limit | At the limit, so the load is run |
| Combined balance after the invoice above the combined limit | The load is not run, and no other programme of the member supplies it instead |
| A payment arriving with no invoice named | Applied on the programme it came in on, oldest invoice first |
| A payment arriving with an invoice named | Applied as named |
